# Fixtures for `fst` (R fst table)

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour): tide readings and tiny models with made-up weights. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/columnar.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tides-uncompressed.fst` | R 4.4.2, fst 0.9.8 (compressed and uncompressed) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides.fst` | R 4.4.2, fst 0.9.8 (compressed and uncompressed) | CC0-1.0 |
